<!-- Embedded Interactive Simulator Scripts -->
<script>
  let frameCounter = 0;
  let telemetryInterval = null;
  let telemetryAngle = 0;

  function updateDiag(msg) {
    frameCounter++;
    const countEl = document.getElementById('hy-telemetry-frames');
    const statusEl = document.getElementById('hy-diag-status');
    if (countEl) countEl.textContent = frameCounter;
    if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = msg;
  }

  // 1. Simulate Plane 0: Edge AI Neural Token Stream
  window.simulateNeuralStream = function() {
    if (typeof HyperFrameCodec === 'undefined' || typeof HyHook === 'undefined') return;

    const outputEl = document.getElementById('neural-ai-output');
    if (outputEl) outputEl.innerHTML = '';

    const tokens = [
      "Analyzing ", "DICOM ", "volume... ", 
      "Identified ", "nodule ", "in ", "Right ", "Upper ", "Lobe ", 
      "[RECIST: ", "14.2mm]. ", "Confidence: ", "98.7%."
    ];

    let i = 0;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      if (i >= tokens.length) {
        clearInterval(interval);
        const eosFrame = HyperFrameCodec.encodeTensor(101, "", true, i);
        HyHook.routeBinaryFrame(eosFrame);
        updateDiag("Plane 0: Neural stream EOS reached.");
        return;
      }

      const frame = HyperFrameCodec.encodeTensor(101, tokens[i], false, i);
      HyHook.routeBinaryFrame(frame);

      if (outputEl) {
        outputEl.insertAdjacentText('beforeend', tokens[i]);
      }
      i++;
      updateDiag("Plane 0: Streamed AI token (" + i + "/" + tokens.length + ")");
    }, 90);
  };

  // 2. Simulate Plane 1: Atomic Hypermedia Morph
  window.simulateHypermediaMorph = function() {
    if (typeof HyperFrameCodec === 'undefined' || typeof HyHook === 'undefined') return;

    const html = `
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between w-full p-2 bg-teal-950/60 rounded border border-teal-500/40 text-teal-200 animate-fadeIn">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span class="text-lg">🩻</span>
          <div>
            <strong class="text-white text-xs block">CT Chest Axial (0.625mm High-Res)</strong>
            <span class="text-[10px] text-teal-300">Target Series #8820 • 640 Slices • Zero-Eval Swapped</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-teal-500/20 text-teal-300 border border-teal-500/30">
          SUB-MS MORPH
        </span>
      </div>
    `;

    const frame = HyperFrameCodec.encodeHypermedia(201, '#hypermedia-target-card', 'innerHTML', html, 1);
    HyHook.routeBinaryFrame(frame);
    updateDiag("Plane 1: Atomic Hypermedia Morph completed on #hypermedia-target-card");
  };

  // 3. Simulate Plane 2: Continuous 60fps Telemetry Vector
  window.toggleTelemetryStream = function() {
    if (telemetryInterval) {
      clearInterval(telemetryInterval);
      telemetryInterval = null;
      document.getElementById('telemetry-btn-text').textContent = 'Plane 2: Start 60fps Telemetry';
      document.getElementById('fps-counter').textContent = 'Paused';
      return;
    }

    const canvas = document.getElementById('telemetry-canvas');
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

    document.getElementById('telemetry-btn-text').textContent = 'Plane 2: Stop 60fps Telemetry';
    document.getElementById('fps-counter').textContent = '60 fps • 0 GC';

    let lastTime = performance.now();
    let frames = 0;

    HyHook.registerTelemetryRenderer(301, (floats) => {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

      ctx.strokeStyle = '#06b6d4';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      const step = canvas.width / floats.length;
      for (let i = 0; i < floats.length; i++) {
        const val = floats[i];
        const y = (canvas.height / 2) + val * 25;
        if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(0, y);
        else ctx.lineTo(i * step, y);
      }
      ctx.stroke();

      frames++;
      const now = performance.now();
      if (now - lastTime >= 1000) {
        document.getElementById('fps-counter').textContent = frames + ' fps • 0 GC Alloc';
        frames = 0;
        lastTime = now;
      }
    });

    telemetryInterval = setInterval(() => {
      telemetryAngle += 0.15;
      const points = 32;
      const floats = new Float32Array(points);
      for (let i = 0; i < points; i++) {
        floats[i] = Math.sin(telemetryAngle + i * 0.3) * Math.cos(telemetryAngle * 0.5);
      }

      const frame = HyperFrameCodec.encodeTelemetry(301, floats);
      HyHook.routeBinaryFrame(frame);
      updateDiag("Plane 2: Dispatched 60fps packed Float32Array frame (32 floats)");
    }, 16);
  };

  // 4. Simulate Plane 3: Speculative Pre-Cognition
  window.simulatePrecognition = function() {
    if (typeof HyperFrameCodec === 'undefined' || typeof HyHook === 'undefined') return;

    const preRenderedHTML = `
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between w-full p-2 bg-amber-950/60 rounded border border-amber-500/40 text-amber-200 animate-fadeIn">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span>🔮</span>
          <div>
            <strong class="text-white text-xs block">Pre-Materialized Patient Analytics</strong>
            <span class="text-[10px] text-amber-300">Speculative State Active • 0.0ms Activation</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <span class="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300">CONF: 94.2%</span>
      </div>
    `;

    const frame = HyperFrameCodec.encodePrecognition(401, 'spec_patient_analytics', 0.942, preRenderedHTML);
    HyHook.routeBinaryFrame(frame);

    const statusEl = document.getElementById('speculative-status');
    if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = 'Pre-Cached (Conf: 94%)';
    updateDiag("Plane 3: Pre-Cached speculative state 'spec_patient_analytics'");
  };

  window.commitSpeculativeNow = function() {
    if (typeof HyHook === 'undefined') return;
    const committed = HyHook.commitSpeculation('spec_patient_analytics', '#speculative-commit-target', 'innerHTML');
    if (committed) {
      document.getElementById('speculative-status').textContent = 'Committed in 0.0ms!';
      updateDiag("Plane 3: Speculative branch committed into DOM in 0.0ms.");
    } else {
      alert("Please pre-cache speculative state first by clicking 'Plane 3: Pre-Cache Speculative State'!");
    }
  };

  // 5. Simulate Plane 4: Swarm Cluster Gossip
  let swarmClock = 100;
  window.simulateSwarmGossip = function() {
    if (typeof HyperFrameCodec === 'undefined' || typeof HyHook === 'undefined') return;

    const nodes = ['edge-gateway-pacs', 'cluster-gpu-node-01', 'mobile-npu-client'];
    const chosenNode = nodes[Math.floor(Math.random() * nodes.length)];
    swarmClock += 15;

    const frame = HyperFrameCodec.encodeSwarm(501, chosenNode, swarmClock, '{"state":"synced"}');
    HyHook.routeBinaryFrame(frame);

    const activeNodes = HyHook.getSwarmNodes();
    const countEl = document.getElementById('swarm-node-count');
    if (countEl) countEl.textContent = activeNodes.length + ' Nodes';

    const listEl = document.getElementById('swarm-nodes-list');
    if (listEl) {
      listEl.innerHTML = activeNodes.map(n => `
        <span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-purple-950/80 border border-purple-500/40 text-purple-200">
          ● <strong>${n.nodeId}</strong> (v-clock: ${n.vectorClock})
        </span>
      `).join('');
    }

    updateDiag("Plane 4: Swarm Gossip synced node '" + chosenNode + "' (v-clock: " + swarmClock + ")");
  };
</script>
